contract.ceiling_rationale: 732 cells x 20 s = the maximum possible charge of the declared matrix, so exhaustion cannot silently omit costly inputs; declared before any scored cell (the V1 8,000 s ceiling covered 366 cells)

acceptance.validity: every recorded cell has one terminal receipt, identity_ok, a valid output (inventory, geometry, labels, witness, simplex, binding) and a valid arm contract (policy / version / configuration / allowed backends / risk shares / epsilon / delta / deadline / terminal attempts); zero published-geometry faults; no deterministic interval conflict across arms or repeats
acceptance.completeness: all 732 declared cells recorded within the ceiling; otherwise INCOMPLETE
acceptance.historical_accepted_preservation: PGM_ACCEPTED both-repeat completions include every task of the 29 both-repeat completions of previous_accepted_cells.json (lost == [])
acceptance.same_round_accepted_preservation: PGM_ACCEPTED both-repeat completions include every PGM_REFERENCE both-repeat completion; a PGM_REFERENCE task that misses a historical success is a reference-reproduction failure, recorded separately, never attributed to the new wrapper
acceptance.historical_experimental_preservation: PGM_EXPERIMENTAL both-repeat completions include every task of the 3283cfd both-repeat completion set (47 tasks) -- requires the hashed extract of the 122 scored 3283cfd PGM cells (prior_experimental_extract below); NOT EVALUABLE when that extract is absent
acceptance.same_round_experimental_preservation: PGM_EXPERIMENTAL both-repeat completions include every PGM_EXPERIMENTAL_REF both-repeat completion (same host, same round)
acceptance.paired_overhead: see cost_criterion; flags hold default promotion pending explanation, they do not fail validity
acceptance.promotion: accepted becomes the shipped default on main only with validity PASS, completeness PASS, historical_accepted_preservation PASS, same_round_accepted_preservation PASS and no unexplained cost flag; no re-tuning to meet any gate

cost_criterion.rule: a task is FLAGGED when PGM_ACCEPTED is slower than PGM_REFERENCE in BOTH repeats by more than 1.25x AND more than 0.1 s (paired, same-round mutual completions)
cost_criterion.effect: a flag holds default promotion pending a recorded explanation; all paired wall ratios and differences are reported
cost_criterion.origin: proposed by the step-1 benchmark review; adopted prospectively in STEP2_AMENDMENT_1 before any scored cell
